system.description:
Some powerful Tzimisce use this power to mark the boundaries of their demesnes with grisly signposts. To activate it, the Fiend grasps a victim and holds her for a full turn while her spinal cord springs through the crown of her skull and out through her body, generally killing her. The rigid spine-shaft then uncoils to some ten feet in length and, if the victim stood on soil or similarly soft ground, drives itself into the earth, forming a stake or signpost that marks the Fiend's territory.

System: The vampire grasps the victim and wins a Physical Challenge (retesting with Medicine) resisted by the victim's Stamina; success inflicts severe damage on the victim that Fortitude cannot resist, and the transfixed victim is left horribly encumbered until she dies, which typically follows shortly even if the initial wound does not kill outright.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book Two: Tzimisce
